name: TechnologyWisdom Bulk Price Manager for WooCommerce
author: Technology Wisdom

sections.description:
TW Bulk Price Manager for WooCommerce is a lightweight tool that allows store owners to update product prices in bulk directly from the WordPress admin panel.
The plugin focuses on category-based bulk pricing, making it easy to apply consistent price changes across selected product groups.
It automatically recalculates sale prices while preserving discount structure, ensuring pricing consistency across your store.
All bulk updates are stored in a history log so changes can be tracked and reviewed later.
The plugin is designed to be simple, fast, and fully compatible with WooCommerce standards.

Key Features

  • Bulk price updates by product category
  • Percentage and flat pricing rules
  • Increase or decrease price adjustments
  • Automatic sale price recalculation
  • Simple product support
  • Bulk change history tracking
  • Lightweight and performance optimized
  • No external dependencies
  • Clean and simple admin interface
  • Completely free

How It Works

  1. Go to WooCommerce → Bulk Price Manager
  2. Select a product category
  3. Choose pricing rule type (Percentage or Flat)
  4. Choose operation (Increase or Decrease)
  5. Enter the value
  6. Select products from the filtered list
  7. Apply price changes
  8. View updates in the product list instantly
  9. Check bulk history in Recent Bulk Changes section

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from WordPress Plugins screen
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Bulk Price Manager
sections.faq:
Will this overwrite sale prices?

No. Existing discount logic is preserved. Sale prices are recalculated based on the updated regular price.

Example:
Regular price: 100
Sale price: 80
After increase: Regular price becomes 110
Sale price becomes 88 automatically

Can I filter products before updating prices?

Yes. Products can be filtered by category before applying bulk updates.

Is there a history of changes?

Yes. Every bulk update is logged in the Recent Bulk Changes section for tracking purposes.

Is this plugin free?

Yes. The plugin is completely free to use.

Does this plugin support variable products?

No. Variable products are not supported in Free version, it will be available in the Pro version.
